topic: The Hidden Order of Chaos: Constants and Structure in Turbulence

sections.title: The Transition to Chaos
lecture_lines: Flow transitions from smooth laminar to chaotic turbulence.
This shift depends on the dimensionless Reynolds Number.
Viscosity acts as internal friction, resisting this change.
animations: Show a shark [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shark.svg] swimming slowly with smooth blue (#0000FF) lines wrapping around it; label "Laminar Flow" in light blue (#ADD8E6).
The shark [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shark.svg] accelerates; blue lines wobble and turn into chaotic swirls (eddies) behind the tail.
Display text "Critical Re Threshold" in red (#FF0000) as eddies become more intense.

sections.title: The Universal Ratio: Reynolds Number (Re)
lecture_lines: Re is the ratio of inertia to viscosity.
High velocity and scale overcome the fluid's stickiness.
This constant dictates if a turbulent structure emerges.
animations: Display formula Re = Inertia / Viscosity; "Inertia" in yellow (#FFFF00), "Viscosity" in green (#00FF00).
Show a "Tug-of-War" visual with a yellow rope (Inertia) pulling against a green rope (Viscosity).

Compare a large Whale [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/whale.svg] (High Re) in turbulent water to a tiny dot (Bacteria [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bacteria.svg], Low Re) in thick honey-like fluid.

sections.title: The Energy Cascade: Richardson’s Vision
lecture_lines: Large eddies capture kinetic energy from the flow.
These primary eddies break into smaller spinning structures.
Energy transfers downward through a hierarchical cascade.
Like nesting dolls, eddies fragment into tinier versions.
This process continues until scales become extremely small.
animations: Show one large swirling blue (#0000FF) circle (Large Eddy) capturing white (#FFFFFF) energy arrows.
The large eddy splits into two medium-sized teal (#008080) swirling circles.
Medium circles split into four small cyan (#00FFFF) circles, forming a hierarchy.
Flash white (#FFFFFF) pulses to show energy flowing from large circles to small ones.
Overlay a "Matryoshka Doll" silhouette inside the circles to represent nesting.

sections.title: The Kolmogorov 5/3 Law
lecture_lines: Energy distribution follows a strict mathematical power law.
In the inertial subrange, energy scales with size.
The spectrum E(k) relates energy to the wavenumber k.
Energy drops precisely along a negative 5/3 slope.
This -5/3 law is the fingerprint of turbulence.
animations: Display the formula E(k) = C * eps^(2/3) * k^(-5/3); highlight k^(-5/3) in gold (#FFD700).
Show a Log-Log graph (Energy vs Wavenumber) with a straight line having a -5/3 slope.
Label the slope "-5/3" in gold (#FFD700) and highlight the line.
Transition graph to "Graphic Equalizer" bars [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/equalizer.svg]; high on the left, dropping quickly to the right.
Highlight the "Inertial Subrange" region on the graph in white (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Dissipation Scale (Kolmogorov Microscales)
lecture_lines: At the smallest scales, viscosity becomes dominant again.
Kinetic energy finally converts into vibrating heat.
The Kolmogorov length eta marks this dissipation limit.
animations: Zoom into the smallest circles (eddies) represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/node.svg]; label size "eta (Kolmogorov Scale)" in light grey (#D3D3D3).
Small eddies slow down and turn red (#FF0000) as they disappear.
Display text "Kinetic Energy -> Heat" in red (#FF0000) with a glow effect.
Show a metal surface [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/surface.svg] with tiny red dots (heat) vibrating intensely.
Highlight the word "Viscosity" in green (#00FF00) showing it dominates at this tiny scale.

sections.title: Summary: The Universality of Turbulence
lecture_lines: Turbulence follows universal laws across all physical scales.
The -5/3 power law appears throughout our universe.
It describes atmospheric winds and vast galactic nebulae.
Chaotic motion masks a deep, predictable mathematical structure.
We find ordered constants within the heart of chaos.
animations: Split-screen: Left shows a cup of coffee with cream swirls; Right shows a glowing nebula gas cloud.
Superimpose the "-5/3 Law" log-log graph from Section 4 across both split screens.
Display final message: "Structured Chaos: The Universal Code of Nature" in bold white (#FFFFFF).
